description: Maharashtra government has now proposed an action plan to reduce human-wildlife conflict in villages near forests.
body_lead: In order to reduce human-wildlife conflict, the Maharashtra government has now approved a ₹260 crore action plan. This includes setting up artificial intelligence (AI)-based alert systems, control rooms, rescue centres, treatment centres and more. All these new changes will not just protect humans but also wildlife. Maharashtra To Set Up AI-Based Wildlife Alert Systems In 1,000 Villages The ₹260 crore action plan approved by the State Wildlife Board was much needed. It will not just help prevent conflicts between humans and wildlife but also help track the movement of wild animals.
